mutations.because: A store read failure must be a 500 with an { error } message, never an empty list — an empty templates array reads as "no templates yet" to every consumer, exactly the ambiguity the list route exists to avoid.

A version string that parses but exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER silently loses precision (Number("9007199254740993") === 9007199254740992), so a request pinning one version could resolve to a different stored version than the one pinned — D123's immutability promise broken a different way. Removing the BigInt range guard restores that silent coercion.
